response.original_title: Once a Soldier, Always a Soldier
response.overview: In the shadow of America’s secret artillery war against ISIS, soldiers Joshua Bullard and Joshua James battle debilitating blast-induced brain injuries and systemic neglect as they struggle to rebuild their lives at home.
